svg.desc: Binder horizontal lockup cropped to a 4:1 canvas with a small even margin.
svg.metadata: Tablestock binder-edition vector production dated 2026-10-10. The open recipe binder is Natasha's own illustration derived from her 2026-09-05 sketch; the Fraunces wordmark is outlined under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. No embedded rasters, gradients, filters, stock graphics, or third-party logo elements.
